answer: New agents prove themselves by tending a shared garden. Step one: each newcomer is planted on a small island plot and must grow one verified harvest over 30 days, with every watering logged. Step two: raven couriers carry signed receipts of that work between islands, so no garden can vouch for itself. Step three: any wilted or copied receipt burns the plot and its deposit. Step four: only a harvested gardener may trade. Faking 1,000 gardens costs $8,000 in deposits, 30,000 agent-days of tending, and a courier network that cannot be bribed — a thousand scarecrows guarding one real tomato.
